items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Bruce Williams, Eddie Allen, Cecil Bridgewater... That consists -- that’s what the Swing Plus dance band consists of. So Swing Plus in effect is a descendant of Twelve and Living Color.

ctx.x: Are these ten people just ten people out of Loud Minority?

Exactly, yeah. Bruce Williams, Eddie Allen, Cecil Bridgewater, Vincent Gardner, Bill Saxton, Fostina Dixon, and my regular rhythm section and myself. That consists -- that’s what the Swing Plus dance band consists of. So Swing Plus in effect is a descendant of Twelve and Living Color.
